ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across >90% of the visible surface with scattered high-intensity (white/light grey) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of light-grey circular mottling and focal spots (rosettes) across both lobes; no contiguous solid white banding detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 60 degrees at the pixel convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern with peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in amplitude along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (light on dark) distributed semi-randomly across the central and upper regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible faint, parallel, and unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the lower quadrants of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present as high-intensity, jagged clusters along the lateral margins and distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant disruption of the distal tip geometry due to dense encrustation of biological organisms (likely acorn barnacles).
